costBoundary.ownerPreference: Avoid unexpected recurring charges; remain on free-tier behavior unless owner explicitly approves a paid change.

diagnosis: Writer concurrency prevents simultaneous D1 mutation but does not coordinate finite daily write capacity across scheduled diagnostics, historical population, smoke/provision, hot-history and resonance/deploy writers. A successful earlier writer can consume quota and cause a later high-priority writer to fail before useful work starts.
requiredRemediation: Create one System2-wide UTC-day D1 write-budget/priority contract spanning isolated writer workflows; do not rely only on concurrency.

Classify writer intents (scheduled operational evidence, historical bulk backfill, bootstrap, smoke/provision, deploy) and define explicit free-tier-safe priority/reservation behavior without purchasing a paid plan.
Before a large write workflow starts, fail/skip with an explicit QUOTA_BUDGET_DEFERRED receipt when reserved headroom is unavailable instead of beginning and colliding with Cloudflare's hard limit.
Do not claim exact remaining Cloudflare quota unless directly observable; use conservative accounting from known rowsWritten plus reservations/estimates.
Avoid redundant schema/provision writes when the isolated D1 schema is already verified ready.
Keep historical resumability/immutability and daily diagnostic evidence semantics unchanged.
Any paid-tier upgrade remains OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED and is outside this correction.
